evidence.title: CyberFactory: Scaling Cyber Security Capabilities with Instances from the Wild

summary: CyberFactory introduced an AI‑powered system that automatically generates and deploys diverse threat instances harvested from live environments, enabling organizations to bolster their defenses at scale. The platform aims to improve detection and response by providing realistic, up‑to‑date attack simulations for continuous security testing.
title: CyberFactory Launches AI‑Driven Platform to Scale Cybersecurity Using Real‑World Attack Instances
